people.text: Joe's family want to go fishing in the morning. His parents would like to spend their afternoon learning about the history of the area while Joe takes part in a sports activity with other teenagers.
Tom and his father are very good surfers and are looking for a beach with challenging waves. They'd also like to do some other water sports and want to eat some fresh fish for dinner.
Zara and her family are interested in seeing ocean wildlife. The children would like to try surfing and they all want to keep their afternoon free for lying on the beach.
Jinnie's family need a beach with safe swimming areas for her younger sister, near a cafe offering good fish lunches. They want plenty of space so they can enjoy playing games together.
Matt and his family all want to go to a popular beach where they can watch an outdoor show or concert as well as do some fun activities.

items.label: A
items.title: Tantsin Beach
items.text: Suitable for all ages, with a calm bay for swimming (lifeguards present), kayaking opportunities, and several fish restaurants. The beach resort overlooks the bay, which is full of colourful fish.

items.label: B
items.title: Eastlee Beach
items.text: Popular for its seafront cafes, fish restaurants, and boat trips to a historic lighthouse. Afternoon sports lessons for teenagers are available, and there's a scenic walking path along the coast.

items.label: C
items.title: Hatton Beach
items.text: Known for challenging surf conditions (not suitable for beginners), offering fishing, diving, and water-skiing. Locally caught fish is served in excellent restaurants.

items.label: D
items.title: Dunley Town Beach
items.text: Features a 14th-century castle with evening classical concerts. The beach is quiet and family-friendly, with a focus on relaxation and historical sightseeing.

items.label: E
items.title: North Beach
items.text: Offers morning surfing lessons (small waves), whale watching in summer, and beach games for children. The beach clubhouse organises activities for all ages.

items.label: F
items.title: Manou Beach
items.text: Families can enjoy boat trips to catch salmon or watch dolphins, and visit a town museum. Beach volleyball matches are organised daily, but the sea is not suitable for swimming.

items.label: G
items.title: Maryland Beach
items.text: The largest beach on the West Coast, with water sports, a water park, and live entertainment. It's a popular spot for families and offers a variety of activities.

items.label: H
items.title: Kaloa Beach
items.text: Features calm waters for safe swimming, soft sand, and palm trees. Ideal for surf lovers and families, with clear water perfect for water sports and relaxation.

explanations.6: Joe 家人上午钓鱼，父母下午学地区历史，Joe 和青少年参加体育活动。B 选项 Eastlee Beach 有青少年下午体育课程，且有前往历史灯塔的船游，符合需求。原文 “afternoon sports lessons for teenagers... boat trips to a historic lighthouse” 对应 “fishing, history, sports activity”。
explanations.7: Tom 和爸爸是冲浪高手，找有挑战性海浪的海滩，还想做其他水上运动、吃新鲜鱼。C 选项 Hatton Beach 以挑战性冲浪闻名，提供钓鱼、潜水、滑水，餐厅供应本地捕获的鱼，符合需求。原文 “challenging surf conditions... fishing, diving, and water-skiing... locally caught fish served in restaurants” 对应 “challenging waves, water sports, fresh fish”。
explanations.8: Zara 家人想看海洋野生动物，孩子想尝试冲浪，下午自由放松。E 选项 North Beach 夏季有观鲸活动，提供冲浪课程，海滩俱乐部组织适合各年龄段的活动，符合需求。原文 “whale watching in summer, surfing lessons... beach clubhouse organises activities for all ages” 对应 “ocean wildlife, surfing, free afternoon”。
explanations.9: Jinnie 家人需要有安全游泳区、靠近供应好鱼午餐的咖啡馆、有足够空间玩游戏的海滩。A 选项 Tantsin Beach 有平静海湾（有救生员）、皮划艇机会和几家鱼餐厅，符合需求。原文 “calm bay for swimming (lifeguards present), kayaking, several fish restaurants” 对应 “safe swimming, fish lunch, space for games”。
explanations.10: Matt 家人想去受欢迎的海滩，能看户外表演或音乐会，做有趣活动。G 选项 Maryland Beach 是西海岸最大海滩，有水上运动、水上公园和现场娱乐，符合需求。原文 “largest sandy beach... water sports, water park, live entertainment” 对应 “popular beach, outdoor show, fun activities”。
